facts.fact: Proparco, the French development finance institution, is investing US$20 million in the South African fibre and connectivity businesses Frogfoot, Vox and Hypa, alongside a Metier-led consortium of BII, BIO, DEG, Ke Nako Capital, Nedbank and Standard Bank; the release gives no signature date, so the year is its publication date (2026-10-05).
